activity_cycle.definition: Time of day when the animal is mainly active.
activity_cycle.name: Activity cycle

age_at_eye_opening.definition: Age at which a young animal first opens its eyes.
age_at_eye_opening.name: Age at eye opening

age_at_first_reproduction.definition: Age at which an animal first produces young.
age_at_first_reproduction.name: Age at first reproduction

age_at_sexual_maturity.definition: Age at which an animal first becomes able to reproduce, when the paper does not give it by sex.
age_at_sexual_maturity.name: Age at sexual maturity

age_at_sexual_maturity_female.definition: Age at which a female first becomes able to reproduce.
age_at_sexual_maturity_female.name: Age at sexual maturity, female

age_at_sexual_maturity_male.definition: Age at which a male first becomes able to reproduce.
age_at_sexual_maturity_male.name: Age at sexual maturity, male

auditory_bulla_length.definition: Greatest length of the auditory bulla.
auditory_bulla_length.name: Auditory bulla length

basal_length.definition: Length of the skull along the base from the front of the premaxillae to the front of the foramen magnum.
basal_length.name: Basal length

basal_metabolic_rate.definition: Energy used per hour by a resting animal at rest, reported as energy.
basal_metabolic_rate.name: Basal metabolic rate

basal_oxygen_consumption.definition: Volume of oxygen used per hour by a resting animal.
basal_oxygen_consumption.name: Basal oxygen consumption

body_length.definition: Length of the body as printed, where the paper does not say whether the tail is included.
body_length.name: Body length

body_mass.definition: Mass of the whole body of an animal.
body_mass.name: Body mass

braincase_breadth.definition: Greatest width of the braincase, not including the mastoid or zygomatic structures.
braincase_breadth.name: Braincase breadth

braincase_height.definition: Height of the braincase from the base of the skull to its highest point.
braincase_height.name: Braincase height

call_duration.definition: Time from the start to the end of a call.
call_duration.name: Call duration

call_end_frequency.definition: Frequency at the end of a call.
call_end_frequency.name: Call end frequency

call_peak_frequency.definition: Frequency with the most energy in a call.
call_peak_frequency.name: Call peak frequency

call_start_frequency.definition: Frequency at the start of a call.
call_start_frequency.name: Call start frequency

canine_breadth.definition: Greatest width across the outer edges of the upper canines.
canine_breadth.name: Width across canines

condylobasal_length.definition: Length of the skull from the front of the premaxillae to the back of the occipital condyles.
condylobasal_length.name: Condylobasal length

condylocanine_length.definition: Length of the skull from the front of the upper canines to the back of the occipital condyles.
condylocanine_length.name: Condylocanine length

condyloincisive_length.definition: Length of the skull from the front of the upper incisors to the back of the occipital condyles.
condyloincisive_length.name: Condylo-incisive length

coronoid_process_height.definition: Height of the coronoid process of the mandible from its base to its tip.
coronoid_process_height.name: Coronoid process height

diastema_length.definition: Length of the gap between the incisors and the cheek teeth.
diastema_length.name: Diastema length

dispersal_age.definition: Age at which a young animal leaves its birth area.
dispersal_age.name: Dispersal age

dispersal_distance.definition: Distance an animal moves from its birth site to the site where it first breeds.
dispersal_distance.name: Dispersal distance

domestication_status.definition: Whether the animal is domestic or wild.
domestication_status.name: Domestication status

ear_length.definition: Length of the external ear from the notch at its base to the tip, not including hairs.
ear_length.name: Ear length

foraging_stratum.definition: Vertical level where the animal mainly forages.
foraging_stratum.name: Foraging stratum

forearm_length.definition: Length of the forearm from the elbow to the wrist, measured along the folded wing in bats.
forearm_length.name: Forearm length

fossoriality.definition: Whether the animal lives mainly underground.
fossoriality.name: Fossoriality

generation_length.definition: Average age of the parents of the current cohort of the species.
generation_length.name: Generation length

gestation_length.definition: Time from implantation of the fertilized egg to birth.
gestation_length.name: Gestation length

greatest_skull_length.definition: Greatest length of the skull from the front of the rostrum to the back of the skull.
greatest_skull_length.name: Greatest skull length

habitat_breadth.definition: Number of habitat types the species uses.
habitat_breadth.name: Habitat breadth

head_body_length.definition: Length from the tip of the nose to the base of the tail, not including the tail.
head_body_length.name: Head-body length

head_length.definition: Distance along the longest axis of the head, from the tip of the snout to the back of the head.
head_length.name: Head length

hibernation_torpor.definition: Whether the animal uses hibernation or torpor.
hibernation_torpor.name: Hibernation or torpor

hind_foot_length.definition: Length of the hind foot from the heel to the tip of the longest toe, not including the claw.
hind_foot_length.name: Hind foot length

home_range_size.definition: Area an individual or group uses during normal activity.
home_range_size.name: Home range size

interbirth_interval.definition: Time between two successive births of the same female.
interbirth_interval.name: Interbirth interval

interorbital_breadth.definition: Least width of the skull between the orbits.
interorbital_breadth.name: Interorbital breadth

island_endemicity.definition: Whether the species is found only on islands.
island_endemicity.name: Island endemicity

litter_size.definition: Number of young born in one litter.
litter_size.name: Litter size

litters_per_year.definition: Number of litters one female produces in a year.
litters_per_year.name: Litters per year

mandible_length.definition: Length of the lower jaw from the front of the incisors to the back of the condyle.
mandible_length.name: Mandible length

mandibular_toothrow_length.definition: Length of the lower tooth row from the front of the canine to the back of the last molar.
mandibular_toothrow_length.name: Mandibular toothrow length

mastoid_breadth.definition: Greatest width of the skull across the mastoid processes.
mastoid_breadth.name: Mastoid breadth

maxillary_breadth.definition: Width of the skull across the maxillae at the cheek teeth.
maxillary_breadth.name: Maxillary breadth

maxillary_toothrow_length.definition: Length of the upper tooth row from the front of the canine to the back of the last molar.
maxillary_toothrow_length.name: Maxillary toothrow length

maximum_longevity.definition: Greatest recorded age of an individual of the species.
maximum_longevity.name: Maximum longevity

nasal_length.definition: Greatest length of the nasal bones.
nasal_length.name: Nasal length

neck_circumference.definition: Distance around the neck at its narrowest point.
neck_circumference.name: Neck circumference

neonate_body_mass.definition: Body mass of a newborn animal at or shortly after birth.
neonate_body_mass.name: Neonate body mass

neonate_head_body_length.definition: Head-body length of a newborn animal at or shortly after birth.
neonate_head_body_length.name: Neonate head-body length

occipitonasal_length.definition: Length of the skull from the front of the nasals to the back of the occiput.
occipitonasal_length.name: Occipitonasal length

palatal_length.definition: Length of the palate from the front of the premaxillae to the back of the hard palate.
palatal_length.name: Palatal length

population_density.definition: Number of individuals per unit area.
population_density.name: Population density

population_group_size.definition: Mean number of animals in a group spread over a given area.
population_group_size.name: Population group size

postorbital_constriction.definition: Least width of the skull behind the orbits.
postorbital_constriction.name: Postorbital constriction

postpalatal_depth.definition: Depth of the skull behind the hard palate.
postpalatal_depth.name: Postpalatal depth

postpalatal_length.definition: Length from the back of the hard palate to the front of the foramen magnum.
postpalatal_length.name: Postpalatal length

rostral_breadth.definition: Width of the rostrum measured across the maxillae at a stated landmark.
rostral_breadth.name: Rostral breadth

rostral_length.definition: Length of the rostrum from the front of the nasals to the front of the orbits.
rostral_length.name: Rostral length

social_group_size.definition: Number of individuals living together in one group.
social_group_size.name: Social group size

tail_length.definition: Distance along the longest axis of the tail, from its base to the tip.
tail_length.name: Tail length

teat_number.definition: Number of teats of an adult female.
teat_number.name: Teat number

terrestriality.definition: Whether the animal lives on the ground or above it.
terrestriality.name: Terrestriality

tibia_length.definition: Length of the tibia along its longest axis.
tibia_length.name: Tibia length

total_length.definition: Length from the tip of the nose to the tip of the tail, including the tail.
total_length.name: Total length

tragus_length.definition: Length of the tragus from its base to its tip.
tragus_length.name: Tragus length

upper_molar_breadth_m2_m2.definition: Greatest width across the outer edges of the upper second molars.
upper_molar_breadth_m2_m2.name: Width across upper second molars

weaning_age.definition: Age at which a young animal stops nursing.
weaning_age.name: Weaning age

weaning_body_mass.definition: Body mass of a young animal at weaning.
weaning_body_mass.name: Weaning body mass

weaning_head_body_length.definition: Head-body length of a young animal at weaning.
weaning_head_body_length.name: Weaning head-body length

zygomatic_breadth.definition: Greatest width of the skull across the zygomatic arches.
zygomatic_breadth.name: Zygomatic breadth

zygomatic_plate_breadth.definition: Width of the zygomatic plate at its narrowest point.
zygomatic_plate_breadth.name: Zygomatic plate breadth
